_note: r.164(3)(c) and (6)(c): "has income from any source outside India". The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27 (W-090d, D-652 G1a): for TY 2025-26 it is Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (IB) (Income-tax Rules, 1962, kept live by r.164(14)); the question names no section, so one wording serves both years.
question: Did you have income from any source outside India?

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-20032026-271092, Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.164(3)(c), p.1662; r.164(6)(c), p.1663; egazette 2018/184509, Income-tax (Second Amendment) Rules, 2018, G.S.R. 332(E), Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (IB), p.177
